title: Domestic violence screening tool should be replaced, Jess Phillips says
summary: Safeguarding minister says tool used to decide which domestic abuse victims get support doesn’t work The main screening tool used to determine which domestic violence victims need support has “obvious problems” and should be replaced, the UK safeguarding minister, Jess Phillips, has said.
